# Weights in seconds for the std/test cases of the selfhost-stdtest jobs.
# corpus.ShardByWeight partitions the cases of each leg by these weights,
# as scripts/shard-tests partitions the self-host tests. A case with no row
# weighs 1. A wrong weight only changes the balance: each case runs once.
#
# Each row is ceil(the slowest observation of the case) in the wasm and
# x86-64 shards of CI run 45547630495 (489edd0f) and in wasm shard 3 of run
# 45491873364 (5b774463). Most interpreter verdicts were not in the cache in
# those runs, so the rows include the cost of the Go oracle. That cost is the
# largest part of a case after a change to the oracle.
